journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association

articles.title_en: Schumpeter Lecture 2023 : Rationality and Zero Risk
articles.title_cn: 熊彼特讲座 2023：理性与零风险
articles.abstract_en: We adopt a definition of “rationality” as robustness to analysis: A mode of behavior is rational for a decision maker if she feels comfortable with it once it has been analyzed and explained to her. With this definition in mind, is it irrational to violate continuity axioms in one’s stated preferences? Specifically, does it make sense to avoid any positive probability of a negative outcome, no matter how small? Or, if a decision maker states such a “zero risk” policy, does she mean what she says? We propose to study this question axiomatically, asking which modes of behavior correspond to such statements. The baseline model evaluates a lottery by its expected utility and an extra additive term that measures the cost of deviating from a “zero risk” choice. A generalized version allows for multiple sets of principles, where the cost of risking a set of principles is added to the expected utility of a lottery. Stronger assumptions imply that the cost of violating a set of principles is additive in the individual costs. We develop a comparative behavioral analysis that allows making interpersonal comparisons about the relative importance of principles.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们采用“理性”的定义为对分析的稳健性：如果决策者在行为被分析和解释后感到满意，那么这种行为模式对她而言就是理性的。基于这一定义，在陈述偏好中违反连续性公理是否是非理性的？具体来说，避免任何正概率的负面结果（无论多小）是否有意义？或者，如果决策者陈述了这样的“零风险”政策，她是否言出必行？我们建议以公理化的方式研究这一问题，探讨哪些行为模式与这类陈述相对应。基线模型通过期望效用和一个额外的加性项来评估彩票，该加性项衡量偏离“零风险”选择的成本。一个广义版本允许多组原则，其中冒险违反一组原则的成本被加到彩票的期望效用中。更强的假设意味着违反一组原则的成本在个体成本上是可加的。我们发展了一种比较行为分析，允许对原则的相对重要性进行人际比较。

articles.title_en: Come Together: Firm Boundaries and Delegation
articles.abstract_en: We jointly study firm boundaries and the allocation of decision rights within them by confronting an incomplete-contracts model with data on vertical integration and delegation for thousands of firms around the world. Integration has an option value: it confers authority to delegate or centralize decision rights, depending on who can best solve problems that arise in the course of an uncertain production process. In line with the model’s predictions, we find that firms are more likely to integrate suppliers that produce more valuable inputs and operate in industries with more dispersed productivity, and that firms delegate more decisions to integrated suppliers that produce more valuable inputs and operate in more productive industries.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过将不完全契约模型与全球数千家企业的纵向一体化和授权数据相对照，共同研究企业边界及其内部决策权的分配。一体化具有期权价值：它赋予权力，根据在不确定生产过程中谁最能解决问题，来决定是集权还是分权。与模型的预测一致，我们发现，企业更可能整合那些生产更有价值投入品、并在生产率分布更分散的行业中运营的供应商，而且企业会将更多决策权授予那些生产更有价值投入品、并在生产率更高的行业中运营的一体化供应商。

articles.title_en: Ethnic Conflict and the Informational Dividend of Democracy
articles.title_cn: 族群冲突与民主的信息红利
articles.abstract_en: Prevailing theories of democracy focus on class conflict. In contrast, we study democratic transition when ethnic tensions are more salient than the poor/rich divide, building a model where (i) ethnic groups negotiate about allocating the economic surplus and (ii) military and political mobilizations rest on the unobserved strength of ethnic attachment. Free and fair elections elicit information and restore inter-ethnic bargaining efficiency. Autocrats can rationally choose democratic transition, even if they risk losing power, as elections reduce the opposition’s informational rent. The predictions of our framework are consistent with novel country-level and ethnic group-level panel correlational evidence on democratization in the post-decolonization period.
articles.abstract_cn: 主流的民主理论关注阶级冲突。相比之下，我们研究当族群紧张比贫富分化更为突出时的民主转型，构建了一个模型，其中（i）族群群体就经济剩余的分配进行谈判，（ii）军事和政治动员依赖于族群依附的未观察到的强度。自由公正的选举能够获取信息并恢复族群间谈判的效率。独裁者可以理性地选择民主转型，即使他们面临失去权力的风险，因为选举减少了反对派的信息租金。我们的框架预测与后去殖民化时期民主化的新颖国家层面和族群层面面板相关证据一致。

articles.title_en: Discretion and Favoritism in Public Procurement
articles.title_cn: 公共采购中的自由裁量权与偏袒
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the consequences of bureaucratic discretion in public procurement. I exploit a Hungarian policy reform, which allows a “high-discretion” procedure below a certain contract value. At the threshold, I document large discontinuities both in procurement outcomes and in the density of contract values, which indicates that buyers manipulate contract values to avoid auctions. I combine the reform and a structural model to find that discretion increases prices and results in the selection of less productive contractors. I also show that high discretion benefits firms with connections to the party of the central government. I use the structural model to document that public buyers are willing to sacrifice more contract value to increase their discretion if more connected firms are operating in the market. I also use the model to simulate the effects of counterfactual procurement thresholds on different procurement outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了公共采购中官僚自由裁量权的后果。我利用匈牙利的一项政策改革，该改革允许低于特定合同价值的“高自由裁量权”程序。在阈值处，我记录了采购结果和合同价值密度方面的巨大不连续性，这表明买方操纵合同价值以避免拍卖。我将改革与结构模型相结合，发现自由裁量权提高了价格，并导致选择效率较低的承包商。我还表明，高自由裁量权有利于与中央政府政党有联系的企业。我使用结构模型来证明，如果市场上有更多有联系的企业运营，公共买方愿意牺牲更多的合同价值来增加其自由裁量权。我还使用该模型模拟了反事实采购阈值对不同采购结果的影响。

articles.title_en: Spillovers in Childbearing Decisions and Fertility Transitions: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 生育决策中的溢出效应与生育转变：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: This article uses China’s family planning policies to quantify and explain spillovers in fertility decisions. We test whether ethnic minorities decreased their fertility in response to the policies, although only the majority ethnic group, the Han Chinese, were subject to birth quotas. We exploit the policy rollout and variation in pre-policy age-specific fertility levels to construct a measure of the negative shock to Han fertility. Combining this measure with variation in the local share of Han, we estimate that a woman gives birth to 0.63 fewer children if the average completed fertility among her peers is exogenously reduced by one child. The fertility response of minorities is driven by cultural proximity with the Han and by higher educational investments, suggesting that spillovers operate through both social and economic channels. These results provide evidence that social multipliers can accelerate fertility transitions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用中国的计划生育政策来量化并解释生育决策中的溢出效应。我们检验了少数民族是否因这些政策而降低了生育率，尽管只有占多数的汉族受到生育配额的限制。我们利用政策的逐步推行以及政策实施前年龄别生育水平的差异，构建了一个衡量汉族生育率负面冲击的指标。将该指标与当地汉族比例的变化相结合，我们估计，如果同龄人的平均完成生育率外生地减少一个孩子，那么一位女性生育的孩子数将减少0.63个。少数民族的生育反应受其与汉族的文化亲近度以及更高教育投入的驱动，这表明溢出效应通过社会和经济两种渠道发挥作用。这些结果提供了证据，表明社会乘数可以加速生育转变。

articles.title_en: Energy Transition Metals: Bottleneck for Net-Zero Emissions?
articles.title_cn: 能源转型金属：净零排放的瓶颈？
articles.abstract_en: The energy transition requires substantial amounts of metals, including copper, nickel, cobalt, and lithium. Are these metals a bottleneck? We identify metal-specific demand shocks, estimate supply elasticities, and study the price impact of the transition in a structural scenario analysis. Prices of these four metals would reach previous historical peaks but for an unprecedented, sustained period in a net-zero emissions scenario, potentially derailing the energy transition. Their production value would rise nearly four-fold to USD 11 trillion for the period 2021–2040. These four metals markets alone could become as important to the global economy as the oil market.
articles.abstract_cn: 能源转型需要大量的金属，包括铜、镍、钴和锂。这些金属会成为瓶颈吗？我们识别金属特定的需求冲击，估计供给弹性，并在结构性情景分析中研究转型的价格影响。在净零排放情景下，这四种金属的价格将达到历史峰值，但会持续前所未有的长时间，可能使能源转型脱轨。在2021-2040年期间，它们的生产价值将增长近四倍，达到11万亿美元。仅这四个金属市场就可能对全球经济变得与石油市场同等重要。

articles.title_en: Time to Grow Up? Adult Children as Determinants of Parental Labor Supply
articles.title_cn: 该长大了吗？成年子女作为父母劳动供给的决定因素
articles.abstract_en: As children transition to adulthood, do they remain a major determinant of parental labor supply? To answer this question, we examine how college costs affect the labor supply of mothers and fathers by exploiting the roll-out of nine generous state merit aid programs in the United States from 1993 to 2004, which made college more affordable. Mothers of college-age children decreased their annual hours of work after the introduction of these state-wide programs, while fathers did not adjust their labor supply. Mothers of college-going children were entirely responsible for the decline in hours of work, where mothers of children who did not go to college experienced no change in hours of work. The decline in labor supply was mainly due to adjustments among high-income, married, more educated, and white mothers, whose labor supply was more elastic to college costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着子女向成年过渡，他们是否仍然是父母劳动供给的主要决定因素？为回答这一问题，我们利用美国1993年至2004年间九项慷慨的州立择优奖学金项目的推出（这些项目使大学教育更加负担得起），考察大学费用如何影响母亲和父亲的劳动供给。在这些州级项目引入后，有大学适龄子女的母亲减少了年工作时间，而父亲则未调整其劳动供给。有上大学子女的母亲完全承担了工作时间的减少，而未上大学子女的母亲工作时间没有变化。劳动供给的下降主要归因于高收入、已婚、受教育程度较高和白人母亲的调整，她们的劳动供给对大学费用的弹性更大。

articles.title_en: Aggregate Properties of Open Economy Models with Expanding Varieties
articles.title_cn: 扩展品种的开放经济模型的总体性质
articles.abstract_en: We present a unified framework to study interconnections between business cycle and international trade models. This unified framework is built upon the standard competitive, representative-firm international real business cycle model and features production externalities in the intermediate and final goods sectors. Our main theoretical result is that this unified framework is equivalent in aggregate implications to dynamic international trade models featuring monopolistic competition, endogenous entry and exit, and heterogeneous firms. We show that a negative capital externality in the intermediate good sector is required to fit the data. This presents a puzzle for the literature because when viewed through the lens of our unified framework, we demonstrate that the standard assumptions used in dynamic trade models imply a positive capital externality.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个统一框架来研究商业周期与国际贸易模型之间的相互联系。该统一框架建立在标准的竞争性、代表性企业国际实际商业周期模型之上，并在中间品和最终品部门引入了生产外部性。我们的主要理论结果是，该统一框架在总体含义上等价于具有垄断竞争、内生进入退出和异质性企业的动态国际贸易模型。我们表明，中间品部门需要负的资本外部性才能拟合数据。这对文献提出了一个难题，因为通过我们统一框架的视角，我们证明了动态贸易模型中使用的标准假设意味着正的资本外部性。

articles.title_en: Risk in Time: The Intertwined Nature of Risk Taking and Time Discounting
articles.title_cn: 时间中的风险：风险承担与时间贴现的交织本质
articles.abstract_en: Standard economic models view risk taking and time discounting as two independent dimensions of decision making. However, mounting experimental evidence demonstrates striking parallels in patterns of risk taking and time discounting behavior and systematic interaction effects, which suggests that there may be common underlying forces driving these interactions. Here, we show that the inherent uncertainty associated with future prospects together with individuals’ proneness to probability weighting generates a unifying framework for explaining a large number of puzzling behavioral findings: delay-dependent risk tolerance, aversion to sequential resolution of uncertainty, preferences for the timing of the resolution of uncertainty, the differential discounting of risky and certain outcomes, hyperbolic discounting, subadditive discounting, and the order dependence of prospect valuation. Furthermore, all these phenomena can be accommodated by the same set of preference parameter values and plausible levels of inherent uncertainty.
articles.abstract_cn: 标准经济模型将风险承担和时间贴现视为决策的两个独立维度。然而，越来越多的实验证据表明，风险承担和时间贴现行为模式存在显著的相似性以及系统性交互效应，这表明可能存在共同的根本力量驱动这些交互。在此，我们表明，未来前景固有的不确定性以及个体对概率加权的倾向，共同构成了一个统一框架，用以解释大量令人困惑的行为发现：依赖于延迟的风险容忍度、对不确定性顺序解决的厌恶、对不确定性解决时间安排的偏好、对风险与确定结果的不同贴现、双曲线贴现、次可加贴现以及前景估值的顺序依赖性。此外，所有这些现象都可以通过同一组偏好参数值和合理的固有不确定性水平来容纳。

articles.title_en: The Life-Cycle Effects of Pension Reforms: A Structural Approach
articles.title_cn: 养老金改革的生命周期效应：一种结构性方法
articles.abstract_en: To assess the life-cycle welfare effects of pension reforms, we provide a dynamic stochastic model of saving, portfolio choice, and retirement featuring a rich characterisation of the pension system. Relying on the exogenous variation from a sequence of Italian pension reforms, we identify and estimate the model, which is then used to draw implications of alternative pension policies. The validated model predicts substantial social security wealth effects on retirement, with the offset between public pension wealth and private savings softened when households can adjust their retirement decisions. We further find important distributional effects of pension reforms, with households’ welfare decreasing more the later in the working life they face the reform. Our findings have implications for the design of pension policies and the support they might generate.
articles.abstract_cn: 为了评估养老金改革的生命周期福利效应，我们提供了一个包含储蓄、投资组合选择和退休决策的动态随机模型，并对养老金体系进行了丰富的刻画。利用意大利一系列养老金改革带来的外生变化，我们识别并估计了该模型，随后将其用于推断不同养老金政策的含义。验证后的模型预测社会保障财富对退休有显著影响，当家庭能够调整其退休决策时，公共养老金财富与私人储蓄之间的抵消效应会减弱。我们进一步发现养老金改革具有重要的分配效应，家庭面临改革的时间越晚在其工作生涯中，其福利下降越多。我们的发现对养老金政策的设计及其可能获得的支持具有启示意义。

articles.abstract_en: Decisions under uncertainty are often made with information whose interpretation is uncertain because multiple interpretations are possible. Individuals may perceive and handle uncertainty about interpretation differently and in ways that are not directly observable to a modeler. This paper identifies and experimentally examines behavior that can be interpreted as reflecting an individual’s attitude toward such uncertainty.
articles.abstract_cn: 在不确定性下做出的决策，往往依赖于其解读本身具有不确定性的信息，因为可能存在多种解读方式。个体对解读不确定性的感知和处理方式可能各不相同，且这些方式对于建模者而言并非直接可观察。本文识别并通过实验检验了可被解读为反映个体对此类不确定性态度的行为。

articles.title_en: Structural Change within the Services Sector and the Future of Cost Disease
articles.title_cn: 服务业内部的结构变化与成本病的未来
articles.abstract_en: In his seminal work, Baumol observed that developed economies suffer from cost disease, i.e., aggregate productivity growth falls because structural change reallocates production to services with low productivity growth. We document that cost disease importantly contributed to the productivity growth slowdown in the postwar U.S. To assess how severe cost disease may become, we build a model of structural change among the goods sector and broad services sectors. Calibrating the model to the postwar U.S. implies that broad categories of services are substitutes and the services with low productivity growth do not take over production. Simulating the calibrated model forward implies that future cost disease will be less severe than the past one.
articles.abstract_cn: 在其开创性研究中，鲍莫尔观察到发达经济体遭受成本病，即由于结构变化将生产重新分配给生产率增长较低的服务业，总体生产率增长下降。我们记录了成本病对战后美国生产率增长放缓的重要贡献。为了评估成本病可能变得多严重，我们构建了一个商品部门与广泛服务业部门之间结构变化的模型。将该模型校准至战后美国，意味着广泛的服务类别是替代品，且生产率增长较低的服务业并未接管生产。向前模拟校准模型意味着未来的成本病将比过去的成本病不那么严重。
